clues.text: Jesus spoke to the crowds this way, and He did not tell them anything without using one.
Jesus told His disciples the meaning of one about a farmer sowing: the seed is the word of God.
Jesus told one about wicked vineyard tenants, and the leaders knew He had spoken it against them.
God told Ezekiel to pose a riddle and speak one to Israel about a great eagle and a cedar.
When Pharisees grumbled that Jesus ate with sinners, He told one about a man seeking his lost sheep.
Peter asked Jesus to explain one about what enters the mouth and what truly defiles a man.
Jesus told one about a widow and an unjust judge, teaching people to pray and not lose heart.
